root_cause: Escape key handler clears input value, causing loss of typed text.
repair_strategy: Modify the Escape case in listController.js navigate function to retain the input value while closing the suggestion list.
expected_accessibility_effect: Escape will close the suggestion list without altering the input value, preserving user input and focus.
functional_risks: Other components may rely on Escape clearing the input value; however the clear event is still emitted, allowing consumers to reset value if needed.
verification_requirements: Ensure Escape closes suggestions and retains input value.
Ensure focus returns to the input after Escape.
Ensure form data reflects the typed value after Escape.
